marketplace_angle: Jobs extend the Solana skills marketplace: hire for outcomes after buying a listing or browse /agent-skills. Listings may use Stripe when configured; job escrow is always SOL/USDC to treasury.
reference_positioning: HYRVE-style hire flow; distinct Solana treasury + vibe-coded catalog.
treasury_custody_note: Job funds are sent to the Vibes-Coded treasury wallet and released after approval, auto-release, or dispute resolution.
hire_model: Workers apply with a proposal; the poster hires one applicant (award). There is no self-accept.
